content.text:
Options of timeseries. Set them in options.
stacking: "none" | "normal" | "percent" = "none" // Stack the series on each other
lineWidth: integer 0..20 = 1 // Width of the lines, in pixels
legend.showLegend: boolean = true // Show the legend
legend.placement: "bottom" | "right" = "bottom" // Side of the chart that shows the legend
tooltip.mode: "single" | "multi" | "none" = "single" // Series that the tooltip shows: the series under the pointer, all series, or no tooltip
Field options of timeseries. Set them in fieldConfig.defaults for all fields, or in the properties of an override.
unit: string // Grafana unit ID of the values, for example bytes
min: number // Lowest value of the value axis
max: number // Highest value of the value axis
decimals: integer >=0 // Number of decimals of the values
displayName: string // Name of the series in the legend and the tooltip
Advanced options not listed: 2. Set advanced to true to list them.
